title: Pharmacy Metric2 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pharmacy:metric2 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for pharmacy metric2 (2) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for pharmacy metric2 (2) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises the smoothed week-long trend in your value from pharmacy metric2 (2).
